## Teaching

I was a teaching assistant for a graduate engineering course from 2023 to 2024, where I gave lectures and recitations and wrote the course assignments.

## Research mentoring

I have co-mentored one Ph.D. student and 13 master's students. Most of that work went into turning a vague idea into a question an experiment can answer, and then into writing the answer down so that someone else can reproduce it.
